summary.text: Ken Yager is a Republican state senator from Kingston representing Tennessee Senate District 12 (Campbell, Clay, Fentress, Macon, Morgan, Overton, Pickett, Roane and Scott Counties), a member of the 106th through 114th General Assemblies. He is Republican Caucus Chairman.

paragraphs.text: Yager was born on January 5, 1947, and earned a B.A. in 1969 and an M.S. in 1972 from the University of Tennessee at Martin and a J.D. from the University of Memphis in 1977.
He is married and has two children.
He served as Roane County Attorney from 1978 to 1982.

In the Senate he sits on the Commerce and Labor and Finance, Ways, and Means committees, and he chairs the Tennessee Advisory Commission on Intergovernmental Relations and the Southern Legislative Conference's Energy and Environment Committee.
